summary: Veritone, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering sales agreement with UBS Securities, Needham & Company, and Craig-Hallum Capital Group. The company may sell up to $50 million of its common stock from time to time on Nasdaq through the agents, who will receive up to 3% commission. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring involved. The filing facilitates ordinary share issuance under an existing shelf registration statement.
